tasks.label: 2. Run Spring Boot Backend
tasks.command: mvn spring-boot:run -f backend/pom.xml -pl service-registry & sleep 5; mvn spring-boot:run -f backend/pom.xml -pl api-gateway & mvn spring-boot:run -f backend/pom.xml -pl auth-service & mvn spring-boot:run -f backend/pom.xml -pl document-service & mvn spring-boot:run -f backend/pom.xml -pl workflow-service & mvn spring-boot:run -f backend/pom.xml -pl compliance-service & mvn spring-boot:run -f backend/pom.xml -pl dashboard-service & mvn spring-boot:run -f backend/pom.xml -pl geospatial-service
